caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot rendered in black pencil on an off-white or beige paper background. The teapot has a round, bulbous body with a slightly flared base sitting on a circular pedestal and features a domed lid with a small decorative finial on top. The spout is elongated and curves upward, while the handle is large and ornate, extending vertically from the upper rim and curving downward with decorative details. To the right of the main drawing, there is a smaller side view of the teapot’s top profile, showing a simple oval shape with the knob at the center and the handle and spout visible at opposite ends. The composition is centered on the main teapot, with the supplementary top view placed to the right. The pencil shading provides depth and highlights the metallic texture of the teapot, with all objects and details executed in shades of gray and black.
title: Silver Teapot
